scope: The main menu has a new order, and F1 is the main menu key.

topics.title: A new main menu
details: File manager is first on the main menu.
Office tools comes next. It holds your writing apps and Email.
Then comes Organizer. It holds your contacts and your schedule.
Address manager used to be called Contacts. Schedule manager used to be called Calendar.
You can still say Contacts or Calendar to open them.

topics.title: F1 is the main menu key
details: Press F1 on any screen to go to the main menu.
Press F1 twice quickly to hear help for the screen you are on.
On the main menu, F1 twice opens the user guide.

topics.title: Favorite apps
details: Press Control+F1 on any screen to open Favorite apps.
To choose your apps, open Options, then My menu. Check the apps you want.
You can also choose Change favorite apps at the end of the list.

topics.title: Going back
details: Leave an app you opened from Office tools, Organizer, or Favorite apps. You go back to that list.
Escape on that list goes to the main menu.

topics.title: Updates come from a new place
details: You install this version yourself, one time.
After that, new versions come to you on their own.
Your settings, email accounts and documents stay as they were.
